narration.full_text: Namaste students! In this section, we'll quickly go over the key learning objectives for our chapter on "Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables". By the end of this lesson, you will be able to define what a pair of linear equations in two variables is. You will also understand the general form of these linear equations. Furthermore, you'll be able to recognize and correctly use key terms like 'simultaneous equations' and 'algebraic reasoning' in context. Let's begin!
